app.name: StudyNight
app.tagline: Your notes, turned into a game.

one.title: Your notes, turned into a game
one.body: Add your slides, notes or a photo of your notebook. A quiz built from your own material is ready in about half a minute.

two.title: Every question shows its source
two.body: Tap the source to see the exact passage from your notes. Questions are checked against your notes before you see them.

three.title: Learn it for good
three.body: StudyNight remembers what you find tricky and brings it back at the right time, right up to your exam.

mood.sleepy: Your streak is waiting — a few questions keep it alive.
mood.encouraging: Add your first notes and let's play.

home.resume: You have a round in progress.

settings.deleteBody: All decks, questions, progress, badges and settings will be permanently removed from this device. This cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.

s1.p: No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no analytics and no cookies. Your decks, questions, progress and profile are stored only on this device.

s2.p: Files you add are read inside your browser; the files themselves are never uploaded. Your decks, questions, answers, streaks, nickname and avatar are kept in your browser's storage on this device. Typed answers are not kept after the round ends.

s3.h: What is sent when you use AI features
s3.p: To build questions, check explanations, answer questions about your notes, read photos and turn speech into text, StudyNight sends short text excerpts from your notes (never whole files), resized photos or page images, and short voice recordings through our server to Groq, the AI provider. Our server handles them in memory only and does not store or log their content; its logs contain only error codes and timings.

s4.p: We checked Groq's data documentation and Services Agreement on 9 November 2026. They say Groq does not keep inference requests by default, but may log inputs and outputs temporarily, for up to 30 days, to fix errors or investigate suspected abuse, unless Zero Data Retention is switched on for the account. Groq is not allowed to use inputs or outputs to train models. Groq stores data in the United States. See console.groq.com/docs/your-data.

s5.p: If you switch on Smart search, a language model is downloaded once from Hugging Face (huggingface.co), which sees your IP address like any website you visit. After that it runs entirely on your device; searching your notes never sends them anywhere.

s6.p: The app is hosted by Vercel, which processes technical data such as your IP address in order to deliver the website and protect it from abuse.

s7.p: Don't upload documents that contain personal or sensitive information about yourself or others. The AI is instructed never to repeat personal data found in documents, but the best protection is not to upload it.

s8.p: You can export all your data (Profile → Settings → Export a backup), delete a deck together with everything made from it, or delete all your data at once. Because nothing about you is stored on our servers, there is nothing else for us to send or delete.

s9.p: StudyNight collects nothing about who you are. It is intended for ages 13 and over.

s10.p: If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above. Questions are welcome via the contact details on the app's store page or project page.

s1.p: StudyNight helps you study your own material. Use it for personal learning.

s2.p: Only upload material you have the right to use. You are responsible for what you upload. Don't upload documents containing personal or sensitive information about yourself or others.

s3.p: Questions, answers, explanations and grades are generated by AI and checked automatically, but they can still be wrong. Always check against your notes, and rely on your teachers and official materials for what counts.

s4.p: StudyNight does not give medical, legal or financial advice. “Ask your notes” only restates what is in your own material.

s5.p: The AI service is free and shared by everyone using StudyNight, so it has limits. Please don't automate requests or try to get around those limits. We may slow down or block requests that look abusive.

s6.p: Challenge links and share cards never contain your notes, only questions, answers, short explanations and scores. You decide who you share them with.

s7.p: StudyNight is provided free of charge and “as is”. It may change or stop working, and to the extent the law allows we are not responsible for losses from using it. Export a backup of anything you want to keep.

s8.p: StudyNight is © 2026 Umit Kayaardi, all rights reserved. Open-source components are used under their own licences (see Licences). Your notes remain yours.

s9.p: We may update these terms; the date above shows the latest version. Continuing to use StudyNight means you accept the updated terms.

about.principleTitle: AI writes the questions. Code decides everything else.
about.principle: The AI only organises your notes into topics, drafts questions from your own passages, double-checks them against your notes and marks which key points an explanation covers. Scores, XP, streaks, review scheduling, difficulty and exam plans are worked out by tested code on your device. No question reaches you unless it passes the check against your notes.
